exceptions.reason: rsa 0.9.10 is retained only as Cargo.lock metadata. Strict inverse-tree commands prove that it is absent from the activated all-target graph and from normal+build execution for every workspace package; any Cargo command error or new reachability fails the gate.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove immediately when rsa leaves Cargo.lock, when a fixed resolved version is available, or when any activated/build/workspace graph reaches rsa.

risk_treatment.exposure: no activated compile-time or runtime reachability
risk_treatment.mitigation: strict successful inverse graphs plus all-workspace execution trees
risk_treatment.rollback: block every release candidate and remove the dependency edge before rebuilding

exceptions.reason: gumdrop 0.8.1 is reachable only through tendermint-testgen as a dev dependency of the vendored finality verifier. It is absent from normal+build execution for every workspace package; target-build, proc-macro, build-helper, or runtime expansion fails.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when tendermint-testgen no longer requires gumdrop or when the finality test generator is replaced.

risk_treatment.exposure: test-only dependency metadata; excluded from normal+build release execution
risk_treatment.mitigation: all-target inverse marker binding and all-workspace normal+build reachability checks
risk_treatment.rollback: disable the affected test path and replace the generator before any release build

exceptions.reason: paste 1.0.15 is an unmaintained transitive compile-time proc macro in the pinned Tendermint/flex-error path. Measured normal+build execution is permitted only for the hepta-research-league workspace package; any additional package, version, path, target, or source surface fails.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when the pinned Tendermint/flex-error stack no longer resolves through paste, no later than the current policy expiry. Any expansion requires a new policy commit and fresh independent exact-head approval.

risk_treatment.exposure: compile-time proc-macro execution while building hepta-research-league; no separately shipped paste runtime component
risk_treatment.mitigation: immutable Cargo.lock, Rust 1.98.1, exact reverse-path markers, all-workspace normal+build closure, no git/external/disconnected packages, and independently owned policy files
risk_treatment.rollback: remove hepta-research-league from release eligibility and rebuild from the last approved lockfile if the path, version, or package reachability changes
risk_treatment.upstream_replacement_plan: migrate the pinned Tendermint/flex-error stack to a maintained macro implementation or remove the dependency

renewal.reason: Replace release-entry guessing with the complete workspace package set, make every Cargo command failure fatal even with empty output, scan all tracked build/deploy surfaces, and align the measured paste exposure with the risk register.
